keys.key.hollowbell.armour_power: With his full armour on: Great Toll (R), or Glass Bell (Sneak + R).
keys.key.hollowbell.attack_look: With his book: send him after what you look at.
keys.key.hollowbell.sit_on_giant: Standing on him (on his safe list): sit down where you stand. Press again, or jump, to get up.

gestures.name: Triple crouch to sit
gestures.description: Crouch three times within two seconds while standing on him (on his safe list) to sit down there. Jump to get up.
